label: cpu4x
note: Summary extracted from the raw Chrome trace; the raw event dump (25-31MB) was discarded.
window: last 2.6s of the trace = the morph
metric: count of Chrome 'AnimationFrame::Render' events and the intervals between them
notAFrameRate: renderedFrames/window is NOT a presented-frame rate: there can be more than one AnimationFrame::Render per vsync, which is why p50 sits well under 8.3ms. Treat the gap distribution as the signal (no interval over ~20ms = no stall), and take the 60Hz cadence from the rAF trace in trace-forward-2.json.
rawTraceDiscarded: yes - 31MB/25MB of raw events removed after extraction; these numbers cannot be re-derived from this repo.
